name: Richard Jaffray
headline: Head of Delivery, Australia.
about:
I have spent 13 years at FNZ, a global wealth management platform provider, progressing from Operations Analyst to Head of Delivery for Australia and member of the Senior Leadership Team. Over seven years of senior leadership, the Australian business has grown significantly, the result of consistent, high-quality delivery across a complex, multi-client portfolio and a team built to perform at scale.
 
At the heart of how I work, I am sales focused. Not in the traditional sense, but in the belief that every client interaction, every delivery milestone, and every difficult conversation is an opportunity to deepen trust and grow a relationship. I have found that the most powerful commercial outcomes come not from pursuing revenue directly, but from delivering so consistently and so well that clients choose to stay, expand, and advocate. That philosophy has shaped everything I do.
 
The work I find most meaningful sits at the point where delivery and commercial outcomes meet. I lead end-to-end programme delivery across major platform implementations and data migrations for some of Australia's largest financial institutions, while simultaneously managing the forward pipeline, contributing to commercial negotiations, and representing the Australian business at the global senior leadership level. Delivery at this scale requires more than good project management — it requires executive relationships built on trust, teams that perform without close oversight, and the discipline to maintain quality under sustained pressure.
 
I manage delivery P&L, coordinate hundreds of people across APAC, the UK, and Europe, and operate across the full lifecycle from RFP and RFI through multi-phase implementation, platform go-live, and long-term client management. I am equally comfortable in a programme governance meeting and a boardroom conversation with a CEO or CFO.
 
Outside of work I am completing executive coaching through Paul Mitchell's Human Enterprise programme — an investment in becoming a more considered and effective leader.
 
Always happy to connect with people working at the sharp end of financial services technology delivery.
